prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished panoramic abstract website background.
Create a brand-new, impeccably constructed parametric graphic. EXACT wide 2:1 aspect ratio, 2048 x 1024 pixels. This is a flat graphic illustration with subtle gradients inside color bands.

DESIGN
A pale dusty-lilac field (#ddd4e8) fills the canvas. The left 53% is quiet uninterrupted background for text. On the right 47%, a sophisticated asymmetric optical lattice of large rounded rhombi and slightly phase-shifted rounded superellipses. The pattern extends beyond the top, right and bottom edges. A main rounded-diamond opening is centered around 81% of the canvas width and 47% of the height, far off-center to the right. Its interior is plain lilac, an elegant open diamond with four smooth generous corners. Wide nested violet diamond bands surround this opening. The bands' centers shift subtly from layer to layer, creating an expressive curved rhythm. Along the left flank and lower flank, a SECOND offset family of rounded-diamond contours joins the composition. Together the two families form broad diagonal channels, a scalloped left silhouette, and two carefully designed narrow saddle-shaped negative-space junctions. Preserve asymmetry and the interaction of the two families; it should be an interesting optical textile, not a single regular concentric target.

GEOMETRY
Design all contours as mathematically clean closed vector paths, using smooth tangent-continuous rounded corners and controlled straight diagonal runs. Use about four broad violet bands at the main scale, two mint inserts and two restrained pale-citron accent paths. Keep all visible bands continuous and fully resolved. Curves are deliberate and smooth, with no wobble. Width changes, where needed, are gradual and intentional; no local collapse, pinches, or tips. Rounded corners have a consistent radius family; the inner diamond remains graceful rather than squashed. At both phase-shift junctions, construct clear lilac negative-space channels so bands remain separated and traceable. Every foreground path has a readable clean boundary. Use one consistent crossing/layer order where contours pass one another; a path continues coherently behind the other. No near-touching contours or accidental merges. Thin citron accents maintain a constant sensible visible width and follow the parent contour smoothly, with no needle-shaped fragments or stray dead ends. The mint inserts terminate only by continuing into a complete closed contour or passing beyond the frame.

PALETTE AND FINISH
Violet (#a78bbd) is the principal band color, with restrained smooth lilac-to-violet gradients confined to each band. Muted mint-teal (#a0c6be) appears in only two broad sections. Very pale citron (#e8edba) forms two narrow rhythmic accents. Background lilac remains clearly visible between shapes. Quiet gentle pastel contrast, sophisticated editorial generative-art feeling, immaculate antialiasing. Smooth uniform surfaces, no grain, no texture, no vague faded veil. The empty left background is a clean constant color.

IMPORTANT
Keep the artwork completely planar: softly shaded two-dimensional geometric bands, smooth optical curves, original mathematical pattern. No extrusion, modeled objects, paper folds, facets, bevels, staircase depth, raised walls, cast shadows, glossy plastic or photographed material.
No malformed contours, wavy outlines, broken bands, missing segments, inconsistent widths, squashed corners, uncontrolled cusps, spikes, hairline slivers, tangled knot shapes, ambiguous overlaps, noisy gradients or fuzzy edges. No circles, orbital spirals, hexagons, flowers, bubbles, typography, logos, watermark, border, frame or interface. A finished precise graphic with the richness of asymmetric phase-shifted rounded diamonds.
